sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Bukijutsu, Fuinjutsu, Wind Release, Lightning Release.

system.description:
You move like a blur and rush forward with explosive power. As a part of casting this jutsu, you move to the furthest unoccupied space in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line from your current position. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks and you can move through another creatures space. Each creature you pass through during this movement must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d6 Wind or lightning damage on a failed save, and half as much on a successful one. If you used your Taijutsu save DC, they instead take your [Unarmed Damage] (or [Weapon Damage] + 3d6 on a failed save or half as much on a success.

Interdiction Seal. If your movement passes through a creature marked with a Speed Seal, you can move an additional 15 feet, but you can change direction after leaving their space. You must still move in a straight line when you change direction. You cannot affect a creature more than once if you somehow can pass through them a second time.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6.
